session_turns.message:
I haven't fixed it, because the fix is in the one place you told me not to touch.

The upload limit is `"maxMb": 5` in `config/default.json`. `src/uploads/validate.js` reads it through `src/config.js`, which just re-exports that file. So an 8 MB PDF is rejected, and the 12 MB test fails on the message "max 5 MB" instead of "max 10 MB". `docs/product.md` says 10 MB, so the config value is what's wrong. Changing `maxMb` to `10` would fix it.

I could instead hardcode 10 in `src/config.js` or `validate.js`. That would make the tests pass. But it would leave the code and production config disagreeing, and it would skip the ops review you want on that value. I haven't done that.

You have two options:
1. You or ops change `maxMb` to `10` in `config/default.json` through the normal review. Nothing in `src/` needs to change.
2. You tell me to override the value in `src/` anyway, and I'll do it.

One more thing to check with ops: `src/api/body-limit.js` derives the API body limit from `maxMb` (plus 1 MB). That limit would go up from 6 MB to 11 MB when the config value changes.

I haven't run `npm test` or changed any files.
